title: GogSMP
description: This server is for people who just want to hang around, talk, build, make friends, and a bunch of other fun things too! Join our discord to join!
body:
This server is for people who just want to hang around, talk, mine, make friends, and a bunch of other fun things too!
Rules:
- No being rude, mean, harassing, threatening, building adult content, etc...
- Don't spam
- No griefing peoples houses, or public structures such as courts, statues, shops, etc... But you can steal from abandon structures
- PvP is only allowed if opposing player is known for PvP if they consent to PvP, if you kill a non-PvP player you shall give back their loot including popped totems, notice, you may be sued in game as well
- Build anything but not adult images
- Feel free to mine but please do not disturb peoples property on purpose
- If you see a player breaking rules please DM @.gog2313 or darkness15654 on minecraft whisper while online
- Server is mostly vanilla at the moment
- Server may be down at times so just DM @.gog2313 on discord to turn it on!
- X-Ray NOT allowed!
- Server version is 26.2
- Join our discord server! (RECCOMMENDED) Discord Link: https://discord.gg/UkrX92kpW6
